scripts.build:all: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.vercel-build: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm run typecheck:api && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/youtube-transcript run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/youtube-transcript run build
scripts.typecheck:api: tsc --noEmit --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck api/healthz.ts api/transcript.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/youtube-transcript --filter ./scripts --if-present run typecheck
